description: S46 T4's mcp.importFile — the HUMAN door that deliberately adopts a legacy mcp.json into the tables (MG3). Success shape: mode dry-run answering the plan (servers/tools/declares added and removed, env NAMES only — MG13 has nowhere for a value to travel), outcome dry-run, nothing written. The actor is the kernel's peer credential stamped by Table.ActorFor and NEVER a param; replace mode answers outcome replaced with counts and the before/after grants for every affected agent. The startup twin (adoptLegacy, actor system:startup) shares this importer and needs no door.
